descriptionHtml:
AULA F2088 Pro Full-Size Wired Mechanical Gaming Keyboard (104 Keys Layout / Dual-Mode Multimedia Knob / Detachable Magnetic Wrist Rest / Clicky Blue Switches / Rainbow LED)

Unlock ultimate durability and ergonomic comfort with the AULA F2088 Pro Wired Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, available now at Turbo Computer Egypt. Featuring a 100% full-size 104-key layout configuration complete with a full numeric keypad, this heavy-duty keyboard is built with an innovative detachable magnetic wrist rest architecture to reduce hand fatigue during long hours of usage. Driven by tactical clicky Blue mechanical switches rated for over 50 to 60 million keystrokes, it provides a highly satisfying tactile activation tracking matrix. The upper right corner features an advanced rotatable dual-mode Multimedia Knob framework, enabling seamless toggling between Media Mode for audio control and Lighting Mode for brightness configurations. Constructed with a premium removable magnetic top cover, this keyboard seamlessly transitions between classic recessed or modern suspended floating key designs layout. Complete with double-shot PBT keycaps layout, high-speed N-Key Rollover full anti-ghosting matrix, and a detachable Type-C wired connectivity path, this system delivers absolute precision for intensive competitive matches and rapid productivity setups.
